fieldsRead.text: The Dutch-taught Public Administration degree studies how policy, government and public organisations shape societal problems, and how their effects can be understood and improved. It combines political, legal, economic and social perspectives with empirical research.

Three UCR routes combine public-policy analysis and empirical methods with institutions, climate governance, or public organisations and leadership. Radboud adds a dedicated Dutch public-administration sequence, specialist policy implementation and a separate bachelor thesis. The UCR routes develop related academic capacities and do not confer the same disciplinary qualification.
The displayed restricted electives are one possible pair from four options and are subject to available places. Course offerings and applicable regulations may change.

A mandatory academic Dutch-language test is linked to a first-year course and adds no credits. Normally 42 of 60 first-year EC are required for positive study advice, with personal circumstances considered.
